column1: # Directories where a privileged binary or a cron-invoked script should never live, because a
# lower-privileged user can influence what is there. Shared by the setuid detector (a SUID file
# here is a planted backdoor) and the cron detector (a root cron running a script here is a
# free privesc). Add your own - a per-app spool, a shared drop folder, wherever your target

column2: user home directories - writable by their owners
